note: 主要子句的主詞是「被執行/被處理」的對象。省略主詞與 be 動詞，只保留 p.p. (過去分詞)

meanings.structure: 省略了主詞 the product 和 be 動詞 was

examples.en: Although the product was introduced only last month, it has already sold out
examples.zh: 雖然上個月才上市，該產品已經售罄。

examples.en: Although introduced only last month, the product has already sold out.

note: 當主詞轉變的時候，主要子句的主詞自己「發出/執行」這個動作，省略主詞，動詞改為 V-ing

meanings.structure: 省略了主詞 Mr. Smith，動詞 signed 必須改為 signing

examples.en: Before Mr. Smith signed the contract, he read all the clauses carefully.
examples.zh: 在簽署合約之前，史密斯先生仔細閱讀了所有條款

examples.en: Before signing the contract, Mr. Smith read all the clauses carefully.

note: 其實都有「自從」的意思，所以後面通常會加 have+v.ed

examples.en: Since 2015, the company has expanded its operations into European markets.
examples.zh: 自 2015 年以來，該公司已將業務擴展至歐洲市場

examples.en: Since the meeting, our team has been working on the new design.
examples.zh: 自那次會議以來，我們團隊就一直在製作新設計

meanings.structure: Since + 過去時間點 / 名詞短語, have/has + p.p

examples.en: Since Ms. Lee joined our company last year, sales have increased by 20%.
examples.zh: 自從李女士去年加入我們公司以來，銷售額已增長了 20%

examples.en: He has lived in Taipei since he graduated from college
examples.zh: 自從大學畢業以來，他一直住在台北

meanings.structure: Since 過去句子, 主詞 + have+ p.p.

meanings.meaning: Since 子句的主詞與主要子句的主詞相同時，可以省略主詞

examples.en: Since taking over the project, David has resolved several key problems.
examples.zh: 自從接手這個專案以來，大衛已經解決了幾個關鍵問題

meanings.structure: Since + V-ing, 主詞 + have/has + p.p.
